svg.title: The identical query, two different moments, two different correct answers
svg.desc: A diagram showing the as-of query pattern applied to zones_snapshot: dbt_valid_from less than or equal to as_of, and dbt_valid_to greater than as_of or dbt_valid_to is null. Applied at a moment inside zone 33's own recorded Brooklyn window, the query returns Brooklyn. Applied at the current moment, the identical query returns Queens. A separate panel shows zones itself, queried for zone 33, only ever able to answer Queens, since it has no dbt_valid_from or dbt_valid_to columns at all to express any other moment. A summary panel confirms 265 zones show exactly one currently-valid row each, and exactly one zone, 33, has more than one version recorded in its own real history.
svg.text: The Identical Query, Two Moments, Two Correct Answers
dbt_valid_from <= :as_of AND (dbt_valid_to > :as_of OR dbt_valid_to IS NULL)
:as_of = a moment inside zone 33's Brooklyn window
this question can't even be asked of it
the only moment it has ever been able to answer
Extended across all 265 zones at once
1 zone (33) -- 2 recorded versions, its own real history
every other zone: unchanged, single unbroken row
Not a contradiction -- the one correct answer for each of two genuinely different moments.
